items.quote: Zahlungsziel: 7 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum, netto ohne Abzug.
items.computation: Rechnungsdatum (invoice date) is 17.12.2025 (Wednesday). Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the triggering event is not counted, so the 7-day period starts on 18.12.2025 and its 7th day is 24.12.2025 (Wednesday). This is a payment owed to a private company (payer's own Land, NW, applies for holiday purposes), and 24 December is treated as a working day and is not a weekend, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
